LuciferBundle25_Scar/Scar_Discussion_Luc.en: Oh, he wouldn't last a single day. Though it might be amusing to see him try.
LuciferBundle25_Scar/Scar_Discussion_Luc.cz: Ó, nevydržel by ani jediný den. I když by bylo zábavné sledovat, jak se snaží.

LuciferBundle25_Scar/Scar_Discussion_Luc.en: He'd miss naps in a cozy cat bed, for sure.
LuciferBundle25_Scar/Scar_Discussion_Luc.cz: Určitě by mu chybělo podřimování v útulném kočičím pelíšku.

LuciferBundle25_Scar/Scar_Discussion_Luc.en: I think you're intimidated by him.
LuciferBundle25_Scar/Scar_Discussion_Luc.cz: Myslím, že z něj máš strach.

LuciferBundle25_Scar/Scar_Discussion_Luc.en: Trust me, the savanna is no place for that unimpressive furball.
LuciferBundle25_Scar/Scar_Discussion_Luc.cz: Věř mi, savana není místo pro tu ubohou chlupatou kouli.

LuciferBundle25_Scar/Scar_Discussion_Luc.en: Intimidated by that? Why, he's barely the size of a hornbill.
LuciferBundle25_Scar/Scar_Discussion_Luc.cz: Zastrašen tímhle? Vždyť je sotva velký jako zoborožec.
